d: As people spent more time in cars, drivers began craving the comforts of home. Factory options promised just that — though not all were created equal. From glove-box cocktail bars to record players and dashboard coffee pots, join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options.

t: Dom Irrera: Live from Las Vegas
d: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Philly native Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy special Live from Las Vegas. Dom's stand-up was honed while growing up in his big Italian family in South Philly. Showcasing his delightful mix of awkwardness and self-depreciation, Andrew Schiavone wins over a New York crowd in his debut special filmed at The Slipper Room. From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming worldview shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps, and first loves.
